editions.basis: Own entry and page (ahp764) in the rate list, agency list ゆうちょ銀行 only. Its rate page returns the same numbers as ahp750 (current window and the 2025-26 history of the 米ドル建 初期死亡保険金抑制型 series were compared on 2026-11-17); scripts/met.py checks the current numbers on every run. No separate series is stored.

notes: The rate pages are a React app: the numbers come from POST https://www.metlife.co.jp/annuityproduct/v1/applications/newpolicyinfo (public, no login), found in the site's own JavaScript bundle and checked against the page opened in the built-in browser. scripts/met.py sends the same requests.

All series are 基準利率 (base_rate) of 利率変動型 forms: the rate applying to contracts concluded in the half-month window, with a lifetime-style crediting afterwards at a rate that follows the 基準利率 (minimum guarantee: USD 16 年2.00%, JPY Ⅰ型24 年0.25%, JPY Ⅱ型24 年0.01%, per the page). effective_date is the first day of the window.

Plans: usd_no_declaration = 一時払終身保険（米ドル建 初期死亡保険金抑制型）, 健康告知なし, age bands 50-59, 60-69, 70-80, 81-90, lifetime guarantee (term_years blank); usd_declaration = 利率変動型（米ドル建 16）, 健康告知あり, ages 0-85, 20-year guarantee, contracts from 2025-10-01 (history from 2025-10-01); usd_declaration_to_2025_09 = the same form for contracts concluded up to 2025-09, shown on the insurer's page as a past-rate list (過去の基準利率一覧, 2025年9月以前のご契約) with MONTHLY contract-date windows from 2016-08-15 to 2025-09; the list states a 基準利率保証期間 per window (30 years until the 2023-03 window, 20 years from 2023-04), stored as term_years; age band not stated on the list; jpy_type1 = Ⅰ型24 健康告知あり (0-75 for 30 years, 76-85 for 15 years); jpy_type2 = Ⅱ型24 健康告知なし (40-75 for 30 years, 76-85 for 15 years). term_years is the guarantee period.

For usd_declaration_to_2025_09 the API's answer to startYear=2000 also carries monthly windows for 2026-01 to 2026-10 that the page never shows (its year selector ends at 2025, checked in the browser on 2026-11-17) and that contradict the list's heading (contracts up to 2025-09). They were removed by the independent check on 2026-11-17 and scripts/met.py skips them; what they represent is not established. There are no windows for 2025-10 to 2025-12 in this list. This series was not cross-checked against a second source.

History starts: usd_no_declaration 2025-04-01 (the API returns nothing earlier), usd_declaration 2025-10-01, usd_declaration_to_2025_09 2016-08-15 to 2025-09-01, jpy_type1 and jpy_type2 2024-07-01. The API's serviceOpenDate for the page set is 2021/07/01, which is the age of the page set, not a launch date. The launch of the current policy forms is not established.

The 円建 forms are not offered by every distributor (the page says so). The same page set also exists for non-bank channels (ahp770 and ahp771: 金融機関代理店以外 and MetLife consultants) with different plans (for example spiswl21 USD 30-year, 5.30% now); those are not collected.
has_mva is null: the page links 解約・減額をご検討の場合 and 指標金利について, which suggests a market-value adjustment, but the pages behind those links were not read.
The brochures and policy conditions were not downloaded. The brochure PDFs listed under documents are per distributor group.
Distributors are the agency list of ahp750 (retrieved 2026-11-17).

Plan names shortened 2026-11-17 (full wording in plan_ja): usd_no_declaration is 一時払終身保険（米ドル建 初期死亡保険金抑制型）, no health declaration, reduced death benefit in the early years; usd_declaration and usd_declaration_to_2025_09 are 利率変動型一時払終身保険（米ドル建 16）, the latter on monthly contract windows; jpy_type1 / jpy_type2 are 利率変動型一時払終身保険（Ⅰ型 24 / Ⅱ型 24）. All five are 基準利率 (base_rate).
Launch date search 2026-11-17: no MetLife release found; the API serviceOpenDate 2021/07/01 is for the page set, not a stated launch. Left null.

Launch date search 2026-11-17 (second pass): metlife.co.jp press and history pages answered HTTP 403 (not worked around); the PR TIMES mirror of MetLife releases and four web searches. Candidates, none a stated launch: a web-search summary of MetLife's corporate history giving 2020-07 (page not saved); the release of 2021-06-30 (sources/met/pages/release_met-be-with-you-plus-2_20210630_2026-11-17.pdf) launching the 健康告知なし plan from 2021-07-01, to be sold as ビー ウィズ ユー プラスⅡ in future; fund history of the 健康告知あり form from 2016-08. Still null.
notes_en: Rates are base rates that follow the market and apply to contracts concluded in each half-month window.
History starts in April 2025 for the no-declaration USD plan, October 2025 for the current USD plan and July 2024 for yen.
A separate past-rate list for USD contracts up to September 2025 reaches back to August 2016 and has not been cross-checked against a second source.
Some windows in 2026 appeared in the data but not on the insurer's page, and were removed; what they represent is unknown.
Launch date not established. Whether a market value adjustment applies is not confirmed, and the brochures and conditions have not been read.

verification.method: A reproducible random sample (scripts/recheck_candidates_b.py, seed recheck-sample:met-be-with-you-plus-2; every metric/plan/currency group, at least 10% per metric/plan, at least 20 rows) plus every outlier (a value outside 0-15%, more than 3 standard deviations from its series mean, or more than 1pp from the previous point) was compared with its saved snapshot by an independent parser; all checked rows matched. A pass over every row also matched.
verification.note: Rows with a retrieved_date after verified_through have not been re-checked. The snapshots carry MetLife's API field names, not on-page labels; values match under the collector's reading of those names, which was not re-confirmed offline.
